tools.compare.py:
import itertools, json, math, random, re, statistics, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).parent
mode=sys.argv[1]
rng=random.Random(4103)
cases=list(itertools.product(['small','fixed','chunked'],['client','server'],['continue','yield']))
variants=['baseline','count','single']
results={':'.join(c):[] for c in cases}
for trial in range(6):
    order=cases[:]
    rng.shuffle(order)
    run_order=variants[trial%3:]+variants[:trial%3]
    if trial>=3: run_order=run_order[::-1]
    for case in order:
        sample={}
        for variant in run_order:
            out=subprocess.check_output(['taskset','-c','2',str(root/f'{variant}-{mode}'),*case,'1'],text=True,timeout=15)
            sample[variant]=float(re.search(r'ns_per_exchange=([0-9.]+)',out)[1])
        results[':'.join(case)].append(sample)
        (root/f'comparison-{mode}.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('trial',mode,trial+1,flush=True)
for name,samples in results.items():
    for variant,base in [('count','baseline'),('single','baseline'),('single','count')]:
        logs=[math.log(s[variant]/s[base]) for s in samples]
        ratios=sorted(math.exp(statistics.mean(rng.choices(logs,k=len(logs)))) for _ in range(10000))
        print(f'{name} {variant}/{base}: reduction={100*(1-math.exp(statistics.mean(logs))):.1f}% CI=[{100*(1-ratios[9750]):.1f},{100*(1-ratios[250]):.1f}] median_ns={statistics.median(s[variant] for s in samples):.1f}',flush=True)

method: Six paired one-second trials per cell, CPU2, balanced variant order and shuffled workload order. Geometric mean ratios; nominal paired-bootstrap 95% intervals, 10000 resamples, no multiple-test adjustment. Shared-host simulated core transport, not network throughput. CHECK=true validates before timing; 100 warmup exchanges precede CHECK=false timing. No sampler or counting allocator in timed builds. Allocation measurements use a separate warmed-up probe.
qualification: Small-message timings support both changes. Large-body results vary, including unchanged-path server controls. Timer-enabled chunked-server/yield is 1.9% slower incrementally versus count-only, but combined versus baseline is inconclusive. No universal large-body benefit or absence of regressions is claimed. Long/many-field head performance remains unmeasured.
